title: Banking Model Atlas
scenario: Maple Harbour Bank — a fictional Canadian retail bank
description: Original retail-banking reference model covering customers, deposits, credit cards, term loans, payments and accounting. Selected synthetic checks are executable; this is not a bank operating platform.

domains.label: Customers
domains.description: Who banks with us and how we contact them.

domains.label: Bank and reference data
domains.description: Shared branch, channel and currency definitions.

domains.label: Products
domains.description: What the bank offers and which version was agreed.

domains.label: Accounts and credit
domains.description: Ownership, account lifecycle and credit limits.

domains.label: Cards
domains.description: Issued cards, their users and their lifecycle.

domains.label: Payments and statements
domains.description: Repayments, billing documents and balance snapshots.

domains.label: Disputes
domains.description: Customer claims and the progress of each case.

domains.label: Onboarding and due diligence
domains.description: Customer onboarding, identity evidence outcomes and product applications.

domains.label: Deposit payments
domains.description: Payment instructions, execution events, settlement and reserved funds.

domains.label: Term lending
domains.description: Applications, decisions, contracts, schedules and principal movements.

domains.label: Accounting and reconciliation
domains.description: Double-entry journals, account-entry mappings and reconciliation exceptions.

domains.label: Fraud operations
domains.description: Signals, investigations and recorded decisions; an alert is not proof of fraud.

domains.label: Collections and hardship
domains.description: Overdue obligations, outreach and agreed support; a promise is not a payment.

domains.label: Rewards and loyalty
domains.description: Enrollment, earning, redemption and points accounting; points are not cash.

domains.label: Customer service
domains.description: Requests, complaints, evidence and communication across the customer relationship.

entities.label: Customer
entities.description: A person with a relationship to the fictional bank.
entities.grain: One natural person.

columns.description: Invented display name; never an actual customer name.

notes: Organizations and beneficial ownership are outside this version.

entities.label: Customer Address
entities.description: An address held for a customer over a period.
entities.grain: One customer address assignment for one purpose and interval.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for customer address.
Person to whom this address belongs.
First invalid day, exclusive; null means open-ended.

notes: Overlapping addresses of the same purpose are disallowed in this fictional scenario.

entities.label: Customer Contact
entities.description: A way to reach a customer.
entities.grain: One contact method for a customer.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for customer contact.
Fictional contact value; example emails use example.com.
Whether this is preferred within its contact type.

notes: Contact history and verification evidence are deferred.

entities.label: Customer Consent
entities.description: A recorded choice about a specific optional purpose.
entities.grain: One consent decision event for one customer and purpose.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for customer consent.
Optional use covered by the choice.

notes: Latest event per customer and purpose defines the current choice. This is not a legal compliance implementation.

entities.label: Branch
entities.description: A servicing location or virtual branch.
entities.grain: One servicing branch.
notes: Virtual branch allows digital accounts without forcing a physical visit.

entities.label: Channel
entities.description: A route through which a customer action occurs.
entities.grain: One interaction channel.
notes: Channel describes origin, not a person or device.

entities.label: Currency
entities.description: A currency reference used by monetary entities.
entities.grain: One currency.

columns.description: Currency code; CAD is the only supported value.
Number of fractional digits; 2 for CAD.

notes: Foreign exchange and cross-currency settlement are excluded.

entities.label: Product
entities.description: A named deposit or credit-card offering.
entities.grain: One product family.

columns.description: Account family supported by this product.

notes: An account refers to a version, not directly to a mutable marketing description.

entities.label: Product Version
entities.description: A dated edition of product terms.
entities.grain: One version of one product.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for product version.
First day no longer offered, exclusive.

notes: Existing accounts retain their booked version after the offering closes. APR calculations are out of scope.

entities.label: Fee Type
entities.description: A category of account fee.
entities.grain: One fee category.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for fee type.

notes: No fee engine or fee schedule is implemented.

entities.label: Account
entities.description: A customer-facing deposit, credit-card or term-loan account.
entities.grain: One account contract.

columns.description: Product terms booked at account opening.

notes: Kind is derived through product_version and product. Account numbers are not stored.

entities.label: Account Holder
entities.description: Ownership or signing authority over an account.
entities.grain: One customer role on an account for an interval.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for account holder.
Account to which the role applies.
Legal or operational role in this fictional scenario.

notes: Deposits can have joint owners. Credit-card and term-loan accounts have one primary owner; supplementary card users are not account owners.

entities.label: Account Status Event
entities.description: A lifecycle change for an account.
entities.grain: One account status event.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for account status event.

notes: The latest event defines current status; historical entries are not rejected using current status.

entities.label: Credit Facility
entities.description: The credit agreement attached to a credit-card account.
entities.grain: One facility per credit-card account.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for credit facility.
Credit-card account supported by this facility.
Must match the linked account currency.

notes: One facility for each credit-card account. Fixed-term loans have a separate loan_contract; underwriting decisions are supplied, not calculated.

entities.label: Credit Limit Event
entities.description: A change in the approved credit limit.
entities.grain: One effective limit change per facility.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for credit limit event.
UTC time from which the limit applies.
Nonnegative approved limit in facility currency.

notes: Latest effective event gives current limit. Available credit also needs holds and balances, so it is not calculated here.

entities.label: Card
entities.description: An issued credit-card instrument.
entities.grain: One issued card instance, including each replacement.

columns.description: Earlier card replaced by this card, when applicable.

notes: No PAN, CVV, PIN or magnetic-stripe data. Debit cards and digital tokens are deferred.

entities.label: Card Assignment
entities.description: The person authorized to use a card.
entities.grain: One card-to-person assignment interval.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for card assignment.

notes: A supplementary user need not own the account. A card has at most one assigned person at a time.

entities.label: Card Status Event
entities.description: A change in a card lifecycle.
entities.grain: One card status event.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for card status event.

notes: Replacement does not move old transactions onto the new card.

entities.label: Merchant Category
entities.description: A fictional grouping for merchant analytics.
entities.grain: One merchant category.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for merchant category.
Display category such as groceries or travel.

notes: Codes are illustrative; no claim of a complete network MCC reference.

entities.label: Merchant
entities.description: A merchant identity observed in card activity.
entities.grain: One merchant.

columns.description: Country code; CA in this scenario.

notes: Merchant identity resolution across acquirers is deferred.

entities.label: Card Authorization
entities.description: A request to approve card spending before posting.
entities.grain: One authorization request.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for card authorization.

notes: An authorization is not a posted purchase. Hold expiry, incremental authorizations and reversals are deferred.

entities.label: Card Transaction
entities.description: A posted purchase or refund received through the card network.
entities.grain: One posted card purchase or refund.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for card transaction.
Related authorization when available; may be absent for offline clearing.
Positive amount; kind determines economic direction.
Business date on which activity was posted.

notes: One authorization may support multiple posted presentments. The relationship does not imply equal amounts.

entities.label: Account Entry
entities.description: An immutable customer-account movement used for statement presentation.
entities.grain: One booked debit or credit on an account.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for account entry.
Card activity behind this entry, if any.
Repayment behind this entry, if any.
Fee category when this is a fee.
Earlier entry reversed by this entry.
Deposit payment instruction behind this entry, if any.
Loan draw behind this principal or deposit entry, if any.
Loan repayment behind a principal reduction, if any.

notes: Customer-facing account entries form a subledger view. The separate journal and posting_link entities support accounting and reconciliation; the model is not a complete bank ledger platform.

entities.label: Payment
entities.description: An external repayment to a credit-card account.
entities.grain: One received payment instruction.

columns.description: Payment currency; must match the account.

notes: All funding is external in this release. No internal transfer or payment-rail implementation.

entities.label: Statement
entities.description: An issued monthly billing snapshot for a credit-card account.
entities.grain: One issued statement for an account and cycle.

columns.description: Signed amount owed at start; negative means customer credit.
Nonnegative supplied amount; calculation is outside scope.

notes: Issued statements are immutable. Reissues and interest calculations are deferred.

entities.label: Statement Line
entities.description: A printed item on an issued statement.
entities.grain: One account entry displayed on one statement.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for statement line.

notes: Amounts come from immutable entries. An entry appears on at most one issued statement in this simplified model.

entities.label: Account Balance Snapshot
entities.description: A supplied end-of-day account balance.
entities.grain: One account and business date.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for account balance snapshot.
Signed deposit funds or credit-card/term-loan amount owed, according to product kind.

notes: A snapshot is a reconciliation reference, not a second source of transactions. Opening positions are required to rebuild balances.

entities.label: Dispute Reason
entities.description: A project-local category for customer claims.
entities.grain: One dispute reason.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for dispute reason.

notes: Not a card-network reason-code catalogue.

entities.label: Dispute
entities.description: A customer claim about a posted purchase.
entities.grain: One dispute case against one purchase.

columns.description: Positive challenged portion of the purchase.
UTC time the case was opened.

notes: The owner or assigned card user may raise a case. A claim does not itself create a refund or provisional credit.

entities.label: Dispute Event
entities.description: A lifecycle event within a dispute case.
entities.grain: One event in a dispute.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for dispute event.
Synthetic operational note; no personal narrative.

notes: Chargeback messages, evidence files and provisional-credit postings are deferred.

entities.label: Onboarding Case
entities.description: A customer onboarding or refresh workflow.
entities.grain: One onboarding case for an existing customer identity.
notes: The customer ID may exist before an account is approved. Workflow status is a current snapshot; full workflow events are deferred.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for onboarding case.
Person whose relationship is being reviewed.

entities.label: Identity Check
entities.description: A recorded identity-verification attempt, without identity documents.
entities.grain: One identity check attempt within an onboarding case.
notes: No identity provider integration or statutory verification claim. Repeat attempts are separate rows.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for identity check.
Synthetic opaque reference; no document number or image.

entities.label: Kyc Review
entities.description: A due-diligence review outcome recorded for a case.
entities.grain: One review attempt within an onboarding case.
notes: A PASS is a fictional workflow outcome, not proof of compliance. No sensitive review narrative is included.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for kyc review.

entities.label: Screening Review
entities.description: A screening result and subsequent review outcome.
entities.grain: One screening attempt within an onboarding case.
notes: No live lists, matched names or automated decisions. Potential matches require separate human review outside this demo.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for screening review.

entities.label: Customer Risk Assessment
entities.description: A dated internal customer risk classification.
entities.grain: One assessment event for one customer.
notes: No scoring algorithm or risk inference is implemented. Latest assessment gives current classification.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for customer risk assessment.
Related onboarding or refresh case, if applicable.

entities.label: Product Application
entities.description: A request to open a deposit or credit-card product.
entities.grain: One product application submitted by a customer.
notes: Term-loan applications use loan_application. Approval need not mean an account has already been booked.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for product application.
Account opened after approval, if booked.

entities.label: Beneficiary
entities.description: A payee saved by a customer for an external payment.
entities.grain: One customer-owned beneficiary record.
notes: An external payee is not assumed to be another modeled customer. Beneficiary changes and fraud controls are deferred.

columns.description: Opaque synthetic destination reference; not a real account number.

entities.label: Standing Order
entities.description: A recurring instruction template for an external payment.
entities.grain: One standing-order arrangement.
notes: Each execution creates a separate payment_order. Holiday calendars, retry logic and a scheduler are not implemented.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for standing order.

entities.label: Payment Order
entities.description: An instruction to move funds from a deposit account.
entities.grain: One customer-authorized internal or outbound payment instruction.
notes: Status comes from payment_event. Internal movements have two customer-account entries; external ones have one.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for payment order.
Internal deposit destination; absent for external instructions.
External payee; absent for internal instructions.
Recurring template that produced the order, if any.
Unique client-request key in this single-bank scenario.

entities.label: Payment Event
entities.description: A lifecycle event for a deposit payment instruction.
entities.grain: One execution event for an order.
notes: Latest event gives status. Posting and external settlement are separate milestones.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for payment event.

entities.label: Payment Settlement
entities.description: An observed external settlement result.
entities.grain: One settlement observation for an outbound order.
notes: One full settlement per order in this version. Partial settlement, returns and incoming rails are deferred.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for payment settlement.

entities.label: Account Hold
entities.description: A temporary reservation of funds on a deposit account.
entities.grain: One reservation associated with a payment order.
notes: Holds affect availability but are not booked account entries. Full available-balance computation is deferred.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for account hold.
UTC release time; null means still held.

entities.label: Loan Application
entities.description: A request for a fixed-term consumer loan.
entities.grain: One application by one primary borrower.
notes: Co-borrowers, collateral and underwriting models are deferred.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for loan application.

entities.label: Credit Decision
entities.description: A recorded lending decision for an application.
entities.grain: One dated decision on an application.
notes: Decisions are supplied synthetic outcomes, not a credit scoring engine. Subsequent decisions are separate rows.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for credit decision.
Approved principal; present only for APPROVED.
Approved term; present only for APPROVED.

entities.label: Loan Contract
entities.description: An accepted fixed-term loan agreement.
entities.grain: One loan contract and its loan account.
notes: Rates, interest accrual, modifications, arrears and impairment are out of scope. Schedule interest values are supplied.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for loan contract.
TERM_LOAN account representing the principal obligation.
Approved decision accepted by the borrower.

entities.label: Loan Schedule Item
entities.description: An expected installment in a supplied repayment schedule.
entities.grain: One installment for a loan contract.
notes: This version stores a schedule; it does not calculate amortization or allocate payments to installments.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for loan schedule item.

entities.label: Loan Disbursement
entities.description: A funded principal draw on a loan contract.
entities.grain: One completed principal disbursement.
notes: One full disbursement to a deposit account in this release. External funding and progressive draws are deferred.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for loan disbursement.

entities.label: Loan Repayment
entities.description: A received external repayment against a loan.
entities.grain: One received repayment with supplied principal/interest split.
notes: Only the principal portion reduces the loan account balance. Interest goes to the accounting journal. Payment allocation and delinquency calculation are deferred.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for loan repayment.

entities.label: Gl Account
entities.description: An account in the fictional bank chart of accounts.
entities.grain: One general-ledger account.
notes: This is a small illustrative chart, not a regulatory chart of accounts.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for gl account.

entities.label: Journal
entities.description: A set of accounting lines posted together.
entities.grain: One single-currency journal for one legal entity.
notes: Every POSTED journal must balance independently. Journals are immutable after posting; corrections use new journals.

columns.description: Unique producer event reference for idempotent ingestion.

entities.label: Journal Line
entities.description: One debit or credit within an accounting journal.
entities.grain: One line within one journal.
notes: A journal has at least two lines when posted. Bank general-ledger balances and customer-account balances have different meanings.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for journal line.

entities.label: Posting Link
entities.description: A reconciliation mapping from customer-account activity to a ledger line.
entities.grain: One allocation of an account entry to a journal line.
notes: The mapped line uses the same debit/credit direction and currency as the account entry. Counterpart ledger lines need not have customer-account entries.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for posting link.
Positive mapped portion of the account entry.

entities.label: Reconciliation Run
entities.description: A recorded comparison between two financial record sets.
entities.grain: One reconciliation execution for one business date and scope.
notes: A COMPLETE run may still contain unmatched items; completion does not mean reconciliation succeeded.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for reconciliation run.

entities.label: Reconciliation Item
entities.description: A match or exception recorded by a reconciliation run.
entities.grain: One comparison outcome within one run.
notes: References are conditional on run scope. A reconciliation result is evidence, not a financial posting.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for reconciliation item.
Entry involved when comparing account and ledger records.
Order involved when comparing payments and settlement.
Statement involved when comparing billing totals.
Signed left-side minus right-side difference in CAD.
Synthetic explanation of the match or exception.

entities.label: Ledger Balance Snapshot
entities.description: One independently supplied ledger account balance at a business-date close.
entities.grain: One independently supplied ledger account balance at a business-date close.
notes: Single CAD legal entity; balances use debit-positive signed amounts.

entities.label: Account Ledger Mapping
entities.description: One customer account mapped to its ledger control account.
entities.grain: One customer account mapped to its ledger control account.
notes: Single CAD legal entity; balances use debit-positive signed amounts.

entities.label: Fraud Rule
entities.description: A versioned project-local detection rule definition.
entities.grain: One immutable rule version.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: No executable fraud scoring or real detection thresholds are included.

entities.label: Fraud Alert
entities.description: A signal requiring review, not a confirmed loss.
entities.grain: One rule-triggered alert about a posted card transaction.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: This extension covers posted-card alerts, not authorization-time decisions.

entities.label: Fraud Case
entities.description: An investigation for one customer, potentially grouping several alerts.
entities.grain: One customer fraud investigation.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.
Customer whose activity is under review.

notes: A case may collect multiple alerts; status transitions are not yet executable.

entities.label: Fraud Case Alert
entities.description: An explicit association between an investigation and a signal.
entities.grain: One alert associated with one case.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: Association is not a verdict. Check customer ownership separately.

entities.label: Fraud Decision
entities.description: A recorded assessment of an investigation.
entities.grain: One dated decision for a fraud case.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: A decision does not itself book a refund or loss.

entities.label: Fraud Action
entities.description: A recorded requested response to a case decision.
entities.grain: One requested action following a fraud decision.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: COMPLETED is supplied evidence; this schema does not call card systems.

entities.label: Delinquency Snapshot
entities.description: A supplied point-in-time view of overdue obligations.
entities.grain: One account delinquency assessment for a business date.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.
Nonnegative days since the oldest unpaid due date.
Nonnegative overdue amount in account currency.

notes: Overdue calculation and payment allocation are not implemented.

entities.label: Collection Case
entities.description: A work item for follow-up on a credit obligation.
entities.grain: One collections case for an account.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: Contact person must have an appropriate relationship to the account.

entities.label: Collection Contact
entities.description: A recorded outreach attempt.
entities.grain: One contact attempt for a collections case.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: No real recordings, phone numbers or collection scripts are stored.

entities.label: Promise to Pay
entities.description: A customer commitment that may or may not be fulfilled.
entities.grain: One recorded payment promise.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.
Positive promised amount in account currency.

notes: KEPT must be supported by payments; a promise is not booked money.

entities.label: Hardship Plan
entities.description: An agreed temporary support arrangement.
entities.grain: One version of a hardship arrangement for a collections case.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.
Synthetic summary, not a legal agreement.

notes: Contract changes, interest treatment and legal eligibility are outside this extension.

entities.label: Collection Case Event
entities.description: A historical observation in a collections workflow.
entities.grain: One dated case event.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: This event vocabulary is descriptive; no transition validator is supplied yet.

entities.label: Reward Program
entities.description: A versioned definition of a points offering.
entities.grain: One program version.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: Points are integer units; no universal cash value is assumed.

entities.label: Reward Membership
entities.description: An account enrollment in a rewards program.
entities.grain: One account enrollment interval.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: The account owns the points in this fictional design; household pooling is excluded.

entities.label: Reward Earn
entities.description: A points earning observation linked to a purchase.
entities.grain: One earning award for a card transaction and membership.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: Multiple awards may represent base and promotional points. Earning rates are not calculated.

entities.label: Reward Redemption
entities.description: A request to spend points on a benefit.
entities.grain: One redemption request.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: A cancelled request should not consume settled points. Fulfillment is not automated.

entities.label: Reward Adjustment
entities.description: A manual or correction-related change in points.
entities.grain: One signed points adjustment.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.
Original award when reversing earned points.

notes: Refund clawbacks need explicit policy and allocation; they are not inferred automatically.

entities.label: Reward Balance Snapshot
entities.description: A supplied points position for reconciliation.
entities.grain: One membership points balance at business-date close.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.
Signed points balance; negative exceptions require review.

notes: Snapshot reconciliation against earns, fulfilled redemptions and adjustments remains future work.

entities.label: Service Request
entities.description: A customer request for assistance.
entities.grain: One service request opened by a customer.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: A request is distinct from a dispute and does not imply financial adjustment.

entities.label: Service Request Event
entities.description: A dated change or update on a service request.
entities.grain: One service request event.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: Late-arrival correction and service workflow transitions are not implemented.

entities.label: Complaint
entities.description: An expression of dissatisfaction tracked separately from routine assistance.
entities.grain: One complaint linked to a service request.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: No jurisdiction-specific resolution deadline or regulatory reporting is claimed.

entities.label: Complaint Resolution
entities.description: A recorded response and outcome for a complaint.
entities.grain: One resolution observation for a complaint.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: A goodwill credit would require a separately booked and reconciled account entry.

entities.label: Communication
entities.description: A recorded communication envelope without message content.
entities.grain: One outbound message attempt for a request.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.

notes: No addresses, tokens or message bodies are stored. Delivery does not prove the customer read it.

entities.label: Document Reference
entities.description: Metadata describing evidence held outside the model.
entities.grain: One external document reference attached to a request.

columns.description: Stable synthetic identifier for this record.
Opaque synthetic reference, not a signed URL.

notes: No actual files or credentials are included. Retention and access control require implementation.

entities.label: Payment Return
entities.description: An observed returned amount against a settled outbound payment.
entities.grain: One separately identified returned installment.

columns.description: Positive returned amount in the original order currency.

notes: Several installments may return one payment. Total returned cannot exceed the settled amount. Source corrections are resolved before this curated snapshot; posted journals remain immutable.

rules.statement: An account opens within its product version offering interval and keeps that version; later product migration is deferred.

Every open account has exactly one active PRIMARY owner. JOINT roles are allowed only for deposits. Credit-card and term-loan accounts have one primary owner. Identical customer/account/role intervals must not overlap.
All validity intervals are [valid_from, valid_to); a non-null end is after the start. Address intervals for one customer/purpose do not overlap; card assignments for one card do not overlap.
Each credit-card account has exactly one facility and an initial nonnegative limit event; deposits have none. Facility currency equals account currency.
Cards belong only to credit-card accounts. Issue precedes expiry. Assignments begin no earlier than issue; PRIMARY card users must be active primary account owners at assignment start.
A replacement references an older card on the same account; no self-reference or replacement cycle is allowed.

Card activity occurs after issue. Linked authorizations must be approved and use the same card, merchant and currency; multiple presentments are allowed. Refunds have no authorization link in this release.

A REFUND references a PURCHASE on the same card, merchant and currency. A PURCHASE has no original reference. Refund posting does not precede purchase posting; cumulative refunds do not exceed purchase amount.
All transaction, requested, payment, entry and claimed amounts are strictly positive. Money is represented as decimal strings in future JSON records, never binary floating-point values.

Exactly the source reference corresponding to kind is populated: CARD→card_transaction_id, PAYMENT→payment_id, FEE→fee_type_id, REVERSAL→reverses_entry_id, DEPOSIT_PAYMENT→payment_order_id, LOAN_DRAW→loan_disbursement_id, LOAN_REPAYMENT→loan_repayment_id. ADJUSTMENT has none. All other source references are null. PAYMENT_RETURN entries use payment_return_id as their sole source reference.

Each card transaction has exactly one original CARD entry for its card account and equal amount; PURCHASE is DEBIT and REFUND is CREDIT. Each POSTED payment has exactly one original PAYMENT CREDIT entry of equal amount for its receiving account. PENDING or FAILED payments have none.

A reversal points to one non-reversal entry on the same account, has equal amount and opposite direction, and posts no earlier. Each original entry may be reversed at most once; partial reversals are deferred.

Statement lines refer to entries on the statement account within its half-open period. For credit-card statements, closing_balance = opening_balance + debits - credits. Cycles on one account do not overlap; each eligible entry appears exactly once in its issued cycle.

Statements exist only for credit-card accounts. Period start precedes end; issue is on or after period end; due date is after issue; minimum due is nonnegative and no greater than max(closing_balance,0).

Between daily snapshots, deposits change by credits minus debits; credit-card and term-loan amounts owed change by debits minus credits. A gap requires all intervening entries. Snapshots may be negative; loan principal interest is accounted separately.

A dispute references a PURCHASE; claim does not exceed its amount. Claimant is an account owner or assigned card user at purchase occurrence. Multiple cases may exist, but only one active case per purchase is allowed.

Effective times are unique within each owner stream (consent also by purpose). Initial states are OPEN for accounts, ISSUED for cards and OPEN for disputes; latest event defines current state. Full allowed-transition matrices are deferred.
All currencies are CAD; payment and card activity currency must equal the associated account currency. Payment destination is a credit-card account.
At most one preferred contact exists per customer and contact type.
Closure date is on or after opening and agrees with the CLOSED event business date. Reopening is deferred. UTC instants map to business dates using America/Toronto.
Consent decisions are immutable events. Current consent is the latest decision for the customer and purpose; absence means no recorded grant.

An APPROVED onboarding case has a latest PASS identity check, latest PASS KYC review and latest CLEAR screening for each required type (SANCTIONS and PEP); all occur no later than closure. Ties within a check stream are disallowed.

A booked product application is APPROVED, has an APPROVED case for the same applicant, and references an account opened with the requested product version. TERM_LOAN requests use loan_application instead.
Risk assessment and linked case refer to the same customer. Next review date is after the assessment business date; no risk score is computed.

An INTERNAL order has a non-null destination account, a null beneficiary and different source/destination accounts. An OUTBOUND order has a beneficiary and no destination account. Both accounts are deposits and currency matches the order; the initiating authority must be checked separately.

Each POSTED or SETTLED internal order has exactly one DEPOSIT_PAYMENT debit on the source and one equal credit on the destination. An outbound order has exactly one source debit. Entries match amount and currency. FAILED or CANCELLED orders have no unreversed posting in this simplified version.
Settlement belongs only to an OUTBOUND order. There is one full settlement per order with equal amount and currency. SETTLED requires a settlement observation; internal orders finish at POSTED.

A hold uses its order source account, has positive amount, expires after placement and is not released before placement. A standing-order execution matches the template account, payee and amount; duplicate scheduled executions must be prevented by the scheduler.

Within an order, event times are unique. Allowed transitions: RECEIVED→VALIDATED/FAILED/CANCELLED; VALIDATED→POSTED/FAILED/CANCELLED; POSTED→SETTLED for outbound only. Returns after posting are a deferred process, not a FAILED rewrite.

A contract uses a non-expired APPROVED decision for the same application borrower and TERM_LOAN product. Contract principal and term equal the approved amounts. Approval is not automatic disbursement.
Installment numbers are unique and positive; principal and interest due are nonnegative. Scheduled principal totals contractual principal. Due dates do not precede acceptance or exceed maturity.

One full disbursement equals contract principal and creates a LOAN_DRAW debit to the loan account and an equal credit to the internal deposit destination. Funding date is not before contract acceptance.

A POSTED repayment has nonnegative principal and interest and a positive total. Its principal portion creates one LOAN_REPAYMENT credit to the loan account when positive, and none when zero. Interest is journaled separately. Total principal repayments cannot exceed disbursed principal.
Each POSTED journal contains at least two strictly positive lines and equal total debits and credits, in its one declared currency and legal entity. A DRAFT journal may be incomplete.

Allocated amounts are positive. For entries included in an ACCOUNT_TO_GL reconciliation, allocations must total the entry amount. Linked line direction and currency match the entry; allocations to one ledger line cannot exceed that line amount. Counterpart lines may be unmapped.

A COMPLETE run has a completion time no earlier than start. MATCHED items have zero difference. ACCOUNT_TO_GL items use account/ledger references; PAYMENT_TO_SETTLEMENT uses payment_order; STATEMENT_TO_ENTRIES uses statement. Exceptions may legitimately have a missing side.
Only APPROVED decisions contain positive approved principal and term. DECLINED and REFER have null approved amounts. Decision expiry is not before its decision business date.
Normal balance is DEBIT for ASSET and EXPENSE, CREDIT for LIABILITY, EQUITY and INCOME. Individual lines may be on either side; normal balance is not a prohibition on opposite entries.

Full internal reversals preserve original entries and append one equal opposite entry per original entry on the same account. Outbound returns use payment_return installments and new PAYMENT_RETURN credits; partial and full returned totals are reconciled separately.

Complete event histories begin in the declared initial state and follow the explicit transition matrix in lifecycle_transitions.json. Effective timestamps are unique per subject; closed and terminal payment states cannot reopen.

For every chart account, closing debit-positive balance equals opening balance plus posted debits minus credits strictly after the opening date and through the closing date. Both trial balances sum to zero.

Every customer account maps to one control account and every booked entry has complete allocations to that control account. Signed account balances reconcile to control balances at opening and closing. Deposit balances are negated for debit-positive accounting.
An alert is a signal, not a verdict. Case-alert associations must concern the case customer; a confirmed decision does not automatically book a loss or refund.
Overdue amounts and days past due are nonnegative. Promises have positive amounts and due dates no earlier than their recorded dates; kept promises require independent payment evidence.

Earning and redemption amounts are positive integer points. Membership, purchase and account ownership must agree. Closing points equal opening plus earnings and adjustments minus fulfilled redemptions.
Request events and complaint resolutions cannot precede intake. Account-specific requests require a valid customer relationship. Documents are references only and contain no credentials.

Returned installments are positive, follow outbound settlement and cumulatively do not exceed it. Each installment has one equal credit on the original source account. PARTIALLY_RETURNED means a positive total below the original amount; RETURNED means the full amount.

journeys.question: Who used the card, what posted, and what happened to the complaint?

steps.text: Find the customer raising the complaint.
Identify their card assignment at the purchase time.
Keep the original card even if it has since been replaced.
Find the posted purchase rather than an authorization hold.
Read the amount and reason for the claim.

journeys.caveat: The highlighted graph explains joins; it does not prove a claim or automatically credit an account.

journeys.title: Explain a monthly statement
journeys.question: How did purchases, repayments and fees affect the amount owed?

steps.text: Read the billing period and opening balance.
Find the items included in the issued document.
Use booked debits and credits to reconcile the closing balance.
Trace card entries to purchases or refunds.
Trace repayment entries to posted payments.

journeys.caveat: This is a branching explanation, not a single SQL join path. Aggregate entries before joining optional source tables; the statement is not an interest calculator.

steps.text: Start with the person, not an approved account.
Open a case for initial onboarding or refresh.
Record identity-check attempts without document contents.
Separate screening results from review decisions.
Follow the requested product to its booking.
